data.title: Infrastructure Engineering
data.tagline: Resilient electrical, utility, and facility systems for critical operations.
data.overview: From load studies to commissioning, we engineer the physical systems that keep production and services running. Our work is judged by resilience, maintainability, and a handover package the client's own team can operate.

problems.title: Capacity constraints
problems.description: Growth is limited by distribution capacity nobody has modelled end to end.

problems.title: Ageing assets
problems.description: Critical equipment is past its design life with no credible replacement sequence.

problems.title: Resilience gaps
problems.description: Single points of failure are known but not quantified or prioritised.

approach.title: Assessment
approach.description: Load, condition, protection, and failure-mode studies against real operating scenarios.

approach.title: Design
approach.description: Coordinated electrical, mechanical, and controls design with constructability review.

approach.title: Delivery
approach.description: Phased execution around live operations and agreed shutdown windows.

approach.title: Handover
approach.description: As-built documentation, spares, training, and a defensible maintenance plan.

capabilities.title: Electrical systems
capabilities.description: MV/LV distribution, protection coordination, and power quality.

capabilities.title: Utilities
capabilities.description: Compressed air, chilled water, steam, and wastewater systems.

capabilities.title: Controls and monitoring
capabilities.description: Metering, SCADA, and alarm strategies that operations can use.

capabilities.title: Commissioning
capabilities.description: Witnessed testing, defect management, and safe energisation.

benefits.title: Predictable capacity
benefits.description: A documented basis for growth and capital decisions.

benefits.title: Fewer unplanned outages
benefits.description: Protection and condition insight aligned to criticality.

benefits.title: Safer operations
benefits.description: Design and documentation that support safe isolation and work.

benefits.title: Cleaner handover
benefits.description: An operating team that is ready on day one.
